    Maps from string modules #

    For a string w and a module M, the chain space of w in M consists of families (c_q) related along the letters of w and satisfying the end conditions. Every entry c_q lies in the numerator num_q of the pair functor at position q (mem_num_of_chain), and every vector of num_p starts a chain (exists_chain). A linear map φ : V → num_p therefore lifts to a compatible family on the block quiver M(w) ⊗ V, hence to a module map M(w) ⊗ V → M (stringHom) with z_p ⊗ y ↦ φ y.

    D.Q.wend (w.vtx q) (w.right q) = w.vtx (Fin.last w.len)
